verdict.rationale: 2FAS is local-first and lets users keep their own data: its pricing page promises 'Freedom to self-host your data', the Pass vault can sync to the user's own WebDAV or cloud, and the source code is on GitHub. There is no documented guide for self-hosting the product's server-side pieces, such as the browser-extension pairing or 2FAS Share, so only data hosting is covered. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted deployment of 2FAS backend services, self-hosting setup docs beyond WebDAV vault sync, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
